scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street scene with a bus turning onto a side street, surrounded by buildings of varying heights and styles, including a tall building with a tower and a shorter building with balconies, under a partly cloudy sky with a few clouds and a blue sky peeking through. The street has a mix of paved and grassy areas, with a few trees and a sidewalk along the curb. A black car drives away from the camera on the left, while a white bus with a red stripe and black windows turns onto the street, passing by a pedestrian crossing marked by a white line and a sign indicating a pedestrian crossing. The bus has a large windowed area on its side, allowing passengers to look out as it moves.
